author: Seung Wook
problem: A chess club runs a single-elimination tournament: each round halves the field, and a player without an opponent gets a bye. Return how many rounds it takes to find a winner among players entrants (players >= 1).
bug_description: The loop runs while slots <= players instead of slots < players, so when the entry count is a power of two it plays one round too many.

comments.accurate: Rounds needed until one player is left in a knockout bracket
comments.wrong_behavior: Rounds in the bracket, which is sized to the next power of two above the entry count
comments.wrong_location: Loop condition verified; check the bracket doubles in size each round
